build_mobile_cv_package: build the mobile_cv Python package using python setup.py sdist
build_nightly_mobile_cv: build a nightly wheel of mobile_cv by setting BUILD_NIGHTLY=1 and running setup.py sdist
get_version_mobile_cv: get the current version string from mobile_cv/__init__.py using the get_version function
install_mobile_cv_deps: install the mobile_cv package dependencies including iopath, diskcache, termcolor, cloudpickle, and tabulate
review_setup_py: review the setup.py configuration for the mobile_cv package including metadata and dependencies
